# Requirements Quality Checklist: Location Awareness and Geofence Guidance

**Purpose**: Validate the QUALITY and COMPLETENESS of the Feature 006 requirements — are they complete, unambiguous, internally consistent, measurable, and free of unstated assumptions? This checklist does **not** verify implementation correctness.
**Created**: 2026-08-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## A. Preview versus Authoritative Business Result

- [x] CHK001 Is the non-authoritative status of every guidance conclusion carried by a requirement, not only by the framing prose section? [Completeness, Spec §FR-039, §"Preview versus Authoritative Business Result"]
- [x] CHK002 Is "labelled as a preview" defined with criteria a reviewer can apply (which surfaces must carry it, what the labelling obligation is), or is it left to implementer judgement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-039]
- [x] CHK003 Is it explicitly required that Attendance acquires a *new* sample at the moment of the punch and that the guidance snapshot is never the payload nor proof of location? [Completeness, Spec §FR-039, §US4-4]
- [x] CHK004 Is "at the moment of the operation" bound to a stated ordering rule (sample acquired *after* the punch is initiated), or is that precision present only in the success criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-039 vs §SC-008]
- [x] CHK005 Are stale-preview requirements complete — what remains displayed, what is relabelled, whether derived statuses keep rendering, and that no silent refresh occurs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §US1-6]
- [x] CHK006 Is the staleness threshold anchored to one authority (the Feature 004 60-second window) with the comparison boundary at exactly 60 s stated rather than implied by "exceeds"? [Clarity, Edge Case, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK007 Is the clock that computes snapshot age specified (device clock vs. server time), given Attendance evaluates freshness server-side against `captured_at`? [Assumption, Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK008 Is the focused map/diagram target explicitly distinguished from an Attendance Location choice, including that it is never transmitted as `selected_location_id` and never survives into a later punch? [Completeness, Spec §FR-023, §US3-3]
- [x] CHK009 Are requirements clear that the preview must not pre-select or bias the punch even when exactly one Location contains the position? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK010 Is the `LOCATION_CHOICE_REQUIRED` integration a definite obligation, or does the "MAY supply the components" phrasing leave it optional and therefore unverifiable? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-042]
- [x] CHK011 Is it stated that the candidate set shown on a `409` comes only from the server response and never from the preview's own nearby list? [Clarity, Spec §FR-042, §US3-4]
- [x] CHK012 Are the "guidance never gates the punch control" requirement and the capability-based affordance rule written so they cannot be read as conflicting? [Consistency, Spec §FR-040 vs §FR-037]
- [x] CHK013 Is the expected-divergence explanation specified as a requirement with content criteria, rather than only as a story outcome? [Measurability, Spec §FR-041]

## B. GPS Semantics

- [x] CHK014 Is the meaning of `accuracy_m` defined anywhere in the requirements — what the value represents, its confidence semantics, its unit? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, §FR-026]
- [x] CHK015 Given the accuracy overlay is drawn at radius `accuracy_m`, do the requirements state what that circle asserts, so it is not read by the user as a certainty boundary? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026, §US5-2]
- [x] CHK016 Are the quality gate and the radius gate stated as two independent gates, with both exact boundaries expressed so independence is objectively testable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-017, §SC-006]
- [x] CHK017 Is the prohibition on accuracy expanding or shrinking the geofence stated for computation *and* for wording, with the forbidden expressions enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK018 Is the membership vocabulary closed to exactly two values, with `UNCERTAIN` or any third value forbidden by name? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK019 Is the distance-to-boundary readout unambiguously scoped as presentation-only — formula, required/optional split, and explicit non-status as a business rule? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK020 Is the boundary readout's trigger condition unambiguous when the position is outside the *nearest* Location but inside a farther one? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-018 vs §FR-019]
- [x] CHK021 Is the distance rule specified by formula, Earth-radius constant, and unit in the requirements, or only by reference to "the same rule as canonical validation"? [Traceability, Spec §FR-014, §FR-043a]
- [x] CHK022 Is the client/server agreement tolerance stated as a requirement value, or entirely deferred to the fixture artifact? [Measurability, Spec §FR-043a vs contracts/geofence-distance-fixture.md]
- [x] CHK023 Are the unusable-sample rejection criteria complete and bounded (finite, range-checked latitude/longitude, finite non-negative accuracy) with the "no partial guidance" consequence stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]

## C. Nearby Locations

- [x] CHK024 Is "nearest" defined as a computable rule including tie handling, with the tie-break declared display-only? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK025 Is an "exact tie" defined precisely enough to be evaluated in floating-point terms (bit equality vs. within tolerance)? [Ambiguity, Edge Case, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK026 Is the *ordering* of the nearby list specified, or only its membership and its cap? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK027 Is inactive-Location exclusion stated as a requirement, with its rationale and its consequence for the "nearest" label? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK028 Are requirements defined for a directory containing zero active Locations, given the "nearest is always identified however far away" rule assumes one exists? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-013a]
- [x] CHK029 Are duplicate/coincident coordinates specified as valid data with a stated disambiguator (`code` alongside name)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, §FR-013, §US3-2]
- [x] CHK030 Are overlapping geofences specified as normal data that must never be merged, collapsed, or reported as an error? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, §FR-024]
- [x] CHK031 Is the list bound stated unambiguously across all four of its parts — count cap of five, containing Locations always included, list permitted to exceed five, no distance cap? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, §FR-013a, §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK032 Is the count cap's status consistent between the clarification (fixed at five, a resolved product decision) and the Assumptions (a readability choice that "changes no rule")? [Conflict, Spec §Clarifications vs §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK033 Is the negated-MUST phrasing "No maximum search or display distance MUST be applied" unambiguous in obligation direction, or should it read MUST NOT? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013a]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Sections A–I map to the requested review areas; section J consolidates the cross-cutting ambiguity, conflict, and assumption findings surfaced while reading spec.md, plan.md, research.md, data-model.md, and contracts/
- Items marked `[Gap]` were raised because the reading found no requirement covering the aspect; items marked `[Conflict]` were raised because two artifacts state the same thing differently

## Review Pass — 2026-08-19 (post-`/speckit-analyze` remediation)

All 89 items were re-read against the amended `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `research.md`, `data-model.md`,
`quickstart.md`, `contracts/`, and `tasks.md`, and are marked `[x]`: every requirements-quality
criterion is satisfied by the current text. Two items required a further specification amendment
during this pass rather than a reviewer judgement:

- **CHK004** — the ordering precision ("the sample is acquired *after* the punch is initiated") lived
  only in SC-008. FR-039 now carries it as a requirement, so the obligation no longer depends on a
  success criterion to be complete.
- **CHK089** — no identifier-stability rule existed. `spec.md` §Assumptions now states that `FR-###`
  and `SC-###` are assigned once and never renumbered, that a suffixed identifier carries the same
  weight as an unsuffixed one, and that a withdrawn requirement is marked withdrawn in place — so no
  downstream citation can silently retarget a different rule.

Two items were reworded because their premise expired: **CHK053** and **CHK083** were written against
an open GR-001 `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` marker. GR-001 is now **resolved by deferral** — the decision
is *not* to amend `docs/CHOT_YEU_CAU.md` §6.2.1 — so both items now ask whether that resolution is
recorded, bounded to FR-028, and accompanied by conditions for lifting it. They are, in the
Governance Resolution section of `spec.md`.

Three items are satisfied by deliberate reference rather than by restatement, and a reviewer should
read them that way: **CHK021** (the haversine rule and Earth-radius constant are fixed by Feature 003
and pinned by the FR-043a fixture — restating them here would breach Principle I), **CHK065** (the
`location.view` / `config.view` grants are referenced, not re-declared), and **CHK061** (FR-029
references Feature 004 FR-036 unchanged, while FR-029a adds the live-position prohibition).
